jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our accounting team. As an 
Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play a crucial role in the creation and execution of our Accounts Payable 2.0 processes, transitioning from manual invoice processing to automated workflows, with a focus on KPI reporting, efficiency enhancement, and transparency. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP.
 

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Test and implement new or updated vendor invoice management systems. 

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices. 

• Create and maintain full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) reporting using advanced Excel and SAP knowledge. 

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.  

 

 

• Proven experience in accounts payable or a similar accounting role with a focus on process improvement. 

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

Are you passionate about global brands and eager to support their development across international markets? Join our team as Global Brand Packaging Specialist, where your organizational skills and project management expertise will be key to driving our brands’ success internationally. 
 

Over de functie:
 
 

• You’ll lead complex, multi-language packaging projects to support the introduction of new products and packaging formats into international markets. 

• For each project you oversee the project lifecyle, from concept to launch, and manage the different process steps. You collect the necessary data and translations from internal stakeholders, guide the conversion of design concepts into artwork, ensure readiness for print and adherence to market regulations. 

• In this role you’ll work closely with various internal teams (Sales & Marketing, Production, Quality, R&D, …) and external stakeholders. Through solid project management skills and a strong working relationship with all stakeholders, we count on you to maintain all projects to the required timelines and keep all parties engaged on the right track. 

• You will join our Natural Foods Global Brand team at our HQ in Lembeke, with brands such as Nakd, Trek, BEAR and Kiddylicious. 

About you
 
 

• You have a Master degree in a relevant field. 

• Whether you’ve gained a first experience or are freshly graduated and ready to launch your career in project management – we’re excited to meet you! 

• Good project management skills with the ability to multi-task and prioritize in view of business needs. 

• You thrive on detail-oriented work and have a strong commitment to accuracy and delivering results. 

• Adaptable to change and cultural differences, with a multicultural flexibility suited for an international role in a growing organization. 

• Strong communication skills in English, enabling effective cross-functional collaboration with numerous stakeholders. 

• And a personality which is in line with our TOP values – Team work, Open dialogue and Passion.

As Business Controller, you will act as a trusted business partner within our Biscuits & Bakery business unit, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to drive profitability, operational excellence, and sustainable growth across our international operations. 
 

About the job
 
 

• Analyze business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and provide recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency. 

• Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and Operations teams to deliver clear commercial and operational analyses that support strategic decision-making. 

• Drive the monthly management reporting, ensuring the accuracy of financial results, KPIs, and performance insights across the business unit. 

• Play a key role in the annual budgeting and transfer pricing processes by challenging assumptions, validating business cases, and monitoring financial impact of investments. 

• Evaluate and support strategic initiatives such as CAPEX investments, new product launches, and cost-saving projects through thorough financial analysis. 

• You report directly to the Finance Director Biscuits & Bakery. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or a related field. 

• At least 5 years of experience in Finance, Business Controlling, or a similar analytical role. 

• Advanced Excel skills, experience with SAP is considered a strong asset. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong relationships, influence decision-making, and challenge stakeholders constructively. 

• Fluency in English, with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for a wide range of business stakeholders.

As an Import & Export Coordinator at Lotus Bakeries, you play a key role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across international markets. You coordinate import and export shipments, manage customs processes, and work closely with logistics partners, internal stakeholders, and customs authorities.
 

As part of the Import & Export team you will:
 
 

• Coordinate and manage international import and export shipments across multiple transport modes (ocean, road, air, and multimodal), ensuring timely delivery while optimizing logistics flows to balance service, cost, and operational requirements. 

• Prepare and submit import and export customs declarations in-house or in collaboration with customs brokers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable regulations. Manage communication with local customs authorities and internal compliance teams to facilitate efficient customs clearance and the timely resolution of customs-related issues. 

• Monitor transport performance and proactively resolve issues such as delays, demurrage, detention, and other operational disruptions. 

• Maintain accurate shipping and customs documentation and follow up on discrepancies or corrective actions when needed. 

• Ensure accurate data entry and management across logistics and customs systems, including master data maintenance and customs decision tables in CAS, while safeguarding data quality, integrity, and compliance. 

• Act as the key operational contact for shipment-related questions and escalations and support the implementation of new logistics and customs processes. 
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transport, Customs, or a related field. 

• A (first) experience with international freight flows and customs formalities has given you a good understanding of ocean, road, and air transport. 

• With your strong organizational and communication skills in both Dutch & English, you are able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining an accurate and detail-oriented approach. 

• Working independently comes naturally to you, while you also enjoy collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve shared goals. 

• A proactive, hands-on, and customer-focused mindset helps you adapt to changing priorities and remain effective under pressure. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office, and experience with SAP S/4 or customs systems is considered a plus. 

• Your genuine interest in international supply chain, trade, and customs motivates you to continuously learn and develop in this field.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.
 
 

• Coordinate food safety, sustainability, religious, ethical, and customer-specific certification schemes across the Group. 

• Monitor certification statuses, audit schedules, renewal timelines, and maintain accurate compliance records and databases. 

• Support the planning, administration, documentation, and follow-up of internal and external audits across production sites. 

• Develop and maintain KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and perform trend analyses to support data-driven decision-making. 

• Track audit findings and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. 

• Provide administrative and analytical support for continuous improvement projects, annual program reviews, and FSQA initiatives. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Bachelor's degree in a food-related or data-analytical field. 

• Experience in an administrative or support role within a technical, quality, or food industry environment. 

• Strong reporting and data management skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office applications. 

• Experience with databases, KPI reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools; knowledge of auditing and certification schemes is a strong asset. 

• Professional proficiency in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus. 

• A detail-oriented, analytical, and structured mindset, combined with flexibility, independence, and a positive attitude.

As a maintenance operator, you are responsible for the preventive and corrective maintenance of production machines. You detect technical faults, solve them independently or report them to your supervisor. You provide technical support to production teams and actively contribute to improvements in installations and working methods. You will also assist in the installation and commissioning of new machines.

Your tasks include:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations

• Resolving mechanical and electrical breakdowns to ensure smooth production

• Providing technical support to operators

• Assisting with new installations (setup, adjustment, parameter settings)

• Proposing improvements to maintenance procedures and technical documentation

• Ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and environmental regulations

• The main focus is on mechanics (pneumatics, hydraulics, welding, bearings, compressors, heavy mechanics), with basic knowledge of electricity.

• Technical degree in electromechanics or equivalent through experience

• Initial experience in industrial maintenance is a plus, but motivated juniors are also welcome

• Strong interest in mechanical maintenance (electricity as complementary knowledge)

• Insight into industrial processes and the interaction between machines

• You work safely, accurately, and follow procedures correctly

• You are stress-resistant and can react quickly in case of breakdowns

• You communicate well and enjoy working in a team

• You speak English and French

• You are eager to learn and open to new technologies

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2

• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion

• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)

• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation

• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C++, and Python

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization

• Control systems for robotics

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics

• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)

• You can communicate fluently in English

In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, vehicle diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, and more.

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

As an operator in the recycling department, you and your colleagues will be responsible for the following tasks:

- filling the goods

You have had technical training or already have experience working within production.

Safe and clean work is important to you

For an automotive company in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a full-time category B Driver for the 'YARD' department. You will work in a two-shift system.

What does the job entail?

As a Yard Driver / operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Main responsibilities:

• Shunting: Safely and efficiently maneuvering and moving vehicles from point A to point B across the yard / terminal grounds.
• Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI): Carrying out final quality checks before vehicles are dispatched to clients.
• Damage inspection: Checking incoming vehicles at the terminal for any existing damage.
• Periodic maintenance checks: Performing checks such as battery health checks and engine runs.

VG 458/BUOSAP

• driver's license: You have held a valid Category B driver's license for at least 2 years.
• language skills: Very good command (speaking and understanding) of either Dutch or English.
• work ethic: Reliable, punctual, and committed to working with precision and care.
• availability: Available full-time to work in a 2-shift rotation (06:30 - 14:15 / 14:30 - 22:15).
As a yard driver / Operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

jobs.occupation: Senior CAPEX Project Manager - Industrial Engineering
jobs.description:
Industrial CAPEX project environment

As Project Manager, you take end-to-end responsibility for complex multidisciplinary investment projects within an industrial process setting. You manage the complete lifecycle and remain accountable for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The work includes both greenfield developments and major modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Manage industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through to commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and control project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline planning in MS Project.
• Drive every project phase, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Act as the primary accountable contact for stakeholders and management during the full course of the project.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams covering mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS expertise.
• Manage scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations affecting cost or schedule.
• Report clearly on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to creating and owning project schedules, not merely following them up.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical skills with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work independently and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You show strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

To support our further growth ambitions, Brantsandpatents is looking for an experienced 
(partially qualified) European Patent Attorney 
with a background in life sciences.
 

As a (partially qualified) patent attorney, you will analyze the R&D activities and innovations of your clients and develop an appropriate IP strategy based on this analysis.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients in the broad field of life sciences.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You'll work from our office in Ghent.

You have or are...
 
 

• A Patent Attorney or Partially Qualified Patent Attorney. 

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in a similar role, preferably in the private sector 

• At least a Masters' degree in life sciences. A PhD is a strong plus. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English.

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
 

Your main responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air 
 
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE) 
 
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...) 
 
• Receiving and processing customs documents 
 
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint) 
 
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests 
 
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status 
 
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum A2 diploma 

• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role 

• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes 

• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems 

• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset 

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing 

• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator 

• Able to work independently and manage priorities
